sentences.text: The petitioner alleges that the respondent no.7 is selling a food product under misleading brand name.

3. The petitioner refers to a communication dated 11th November, 2024 addressed to the petitioner by the Director of the Regulatory Compliance Division, Food Safety Standards Authority of India mentioning that the use of the name 'Doctor's Choice' is a misleading trademark by the Food Business Operator which poses a significant threat to consumer safety and health.

entities.text: Food Safety Standards Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 4. Prayer has been made to immediately stop the private respondent from selling the product with the said trade name and label.
5. Learned counsel representing the private respondent submits that the writ petition will not be maintainable here as the petitioner already has an alternative remedy.

6. Prayer has been made to permit the private respondent to file affidavit in the matter.
7.
Learned advocate representing the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India seeks time to file affidavit.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 8. Learned advocate representing the State respondents relies upon the communications made by the State Regulatory Authority intimating the petitioner that the license in favour of the private respondent is issued by the Central Government and, accordingly, it is the central authority that is to take steps in the matter.
9. Upon hearing the parties it appears that the writ petition is to be decided upon exchange of affidavits.
10. Let affidavit-in-opposition by the respondents be filed within three weeks.
Reply, if any, within a fortnight thereafter.

11. Liberty to mention the matter for hearing upon completion of affidavits.
12.

Pendency of the writ petition will, however, not stand in the way of the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India to take necessary measures to stop and/or prevent any food product being sold under misleading trademark by the Food Business Operator.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 13. The point of maintainability as raised by the private respondent is kept open to be decided at the time of final hearing.

14. The instruction forwarded by the Commissioner, Food Safety & Additional Secretary (Health),
respondent no. 2 be retained with the records.
15. All parties are to act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
